# Filters

Holds the filters used by a ListBy query.

## Builders

| Builder | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `filter.Range(field string) RangeFilter` | Filters a field by a lower and an upper bound. |
| `filter.Search(field string) SearchFilter` | Filters a field by a text pattern. |
| `filter.Eq(field string) EqFilter` | Filters a field by an exact value. |

A plain field name given to `query.ListBy` becomes `filter.Eq`, so `query.ListBy("org_id")` and `query.ListBy(filter.Eq("org_id"))` are the same.

## Range

`filter.Range(field string) RangeFilter`

Filters a field by a lower and an upper bound.

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `GetField() string` | Returns the field the filter works on. |
| `IsOptional() bool` | Reports if the filter can be skipped at call time. |
| `Optional() RangeFilter` | Makes the filter skippable at call time. |
